method_note: Read the whole target (2131 lines). Chose claims that a test oracle would rely on: W3C/IETF/OpenID/DIF/GS1 versions and statuses, JOSE/DI/Status List mechanisms, UNTP schema and requirement levels, EU legal citations (checked against the consolidated 2024/1781 text and 2026/1778), GitHub metadata via gh api, DOIs via Crossref/OpenAlex, and existing_check names against src/dppce. Several rows bundle related claims (for example 11 repositories, 12 DOIs). Not re-checked: Commission slides, ISO/IEC 18975 (fenced), EUDI ARF content, the last 100k+ characters of the long specs, remaining 5 DOIs (OpenAlex-only records opus-7940, COBALT-P, GI paper, arXiv 2401.08196, bdcc7020079).

checked.claim: Securing VCs using JOSE and COSE is a W3C Recommendation dated 2026-10-13
checked.evidence: Page status line reads Recommendation, 13 October 2026. Repo log (gh api w3c/vc-jose-cose/commits) shows 2026-10-02 commit removing old CR text (Fix #345), 2026-10-08 publication prep; issue 345 'CR leftover text in the status section' is closed. Editorial reading is consistent.

checked.claim: JOSE rules: typ vc+jwt SHOULD, cty vc SHOULD, claims vc and vp MUST NOT be present; COSE typ application/vc+cose, content type application/vc
checked.evidence: Sections 3.1.1, 3.1.3 and 3.3.1 as the file says; media type registrations include application/vc+jwt, application/vc+sd-jwt, application/vc+cose (section 6.1). Registration text itself was past the fetched part.

checked.claim: Bitstring Status List 1.0 is a Recommendation of 2025-05-15; min 131,072 entries; statusListIndex is a base-10 string; encodedList is GZIP plus multibase base64url; index 0 is left-most bit; errors STATUS_RETRIEVAL_ERROR, STATUS_VERIFICATION_ERROR, STATUS_LIST_LENGTH_ERROR
checked.evidence: All points match the Recommendation text. Purposes refresh, revocation, suspension, message confirmed.

checked.claim: DID 1.1 is a Candidate Recommendation Snapshot of 2026-03-05; DID Resolution split to v0.3
checked.evidence: Status section: CR Snapshot 05 March 2026, resolution moved to DID Resolution v0.3.

checked.claim: UNTP 0.7.0 is Pilots under Maintained; WIP is Testing; no 0.8.0 or 1.0 entry; 0.6.0 Unmaintained
checked.evidence: Table lists Work in Progress/Testing, 0.7.0/Pilots/Maintained, 0.6.0/Unmaintained; no 0.8.0 or 1.0 row.

checked.claim: Git tag v0.7.0 dated 2026-05-04, no newer final tag
checked.evidence: Tag list shows v0.7.0 on May 04 2026, v0.7.0-rc7/rc8 on May 05 2026 (release candidates, not final), v0.6.1 on Jun 16 2025. The GitHub mirror uncefact/spec-untp only has tag v0.6.1 (pushed 2025-11-14), so the file's choice of the unicc GitLab is right, but the file should say that GitHub is stale.
checked.correction: Add: the GitHub mirror uncefact/spec-untp is stale (latest tag v0.6.1); rc7 and rc8 are dated after v0.7.0.

checked.claim: UNTP 0.7.0 DPP schema: root required @context,id,issuer,validFrom,name,credentialSubject; Product required id,name,idScheme,idGranularity,productCategory,producedAtFacility,countryOfProduction; @context prefixItems W3C v2 then untp 0.7.0 context, minItems 2; statusListIndex typed integer; no $id; 2020-12
checked.evidence: All arrays and the context pins match. statusListIndex is integer (minimum 0) while its own description says string in base 10, so the schema is internally inconsistent; the file's conflict finding holds.

checked.claim: UNTP IDR: IDR-04, -05, -06, -07 are MUST; default redirect without linkType but no 3xx code fixed; /.well-known/resolver; link types dpp, dcc, dfr (plus dte, idr, pip, edit in examples)
checked.evidence: Levels and examples match. The description file at /.well-known/resolver is a SHOULD for operators and the page ties it to a protected ISO/IEC standard (not read). Note the file's wording 'IDR names /.well-known/resolver but format undefined' is correct.
checked.correction: Add that the UNTP description file is SHOULD, not MUST, so an engine check must not fail on its absence.

checked.claim: Query parameter decryptionKey carries the symmetric key in the QR URL; minimum key length 128 bit; DID-Authentication SHOULD, DID-SIOP or OpenID4VP MAY
checked.evidence: Shared Secrets section uses the decryptionKey parameter; 128 bit minimum; SHOULD/MAY wording as stated. The IDR page does not use the term (the file cites the DAC page correctly). The page's own 20-hex-character example is below 128 bit.

checked.claim: UNTP 0.7.0 VC profile: VCDM 2.0 JSON-LD compacted; JOSE enveloping proof MUST; did:web MUST implement, SHOULD own domain; did:webvh MUST where auditability needed; Bitstring Status List MUST; goods identifier in credentialSubject MUST
checked.evidence: All levels match. The 0.7.0 page already has renderMethod as SHOULD; the file attributes renderMethod and digestMultibase only to the WIP page and calls the template 'optional' in the summary.
checked.correction: Note renderMethod SHOULD exists already in 0.7.0; digestMultibase rule is WIP.

checked.claim: UNTP WIP: issuers MUST produce JOSE or COSE, verifiers MUST verify both
checked.evidence: The WIP page marks the JOSE-or-COSE rule as Proposed for working-group decision (not yet merged, vote #759). Status-list resolvability (MUST), exact signed bytes in archives (MUST), versioned @context (MUST), renderMethod digest (SHOULD) are correctly stated, SCITT is roadmap only.
checked.correction: Write 'proposed' (not MUST) for the JOSE-or-COSE rule in L08 mechanism; the summary line 'WIP adds' and the vc+cose variant label already say proposal.

checked.claim: GS1-Conformant Resolver 1.2.1 ratified August 2026; /.well-known/gs1resolver with resolverRoot and supportedPrimaryKeys; linkType=linkset or Accept application/linkset+json returns linkset without redirect; absent linkType value gives 404 (changed from 1.1); redirect code not fixed
checked.evidence: Release 1.2.1 (PDF dated 2026-08-07), all behaviours match; 400/404/300 codes defined, 200 forbidden for errors. Last 7148 characters of the page not read.

checked.claim: did:web maps domain to https://host/.well-known/did.json and path DIDs to /path/did.json, port percent-encoded; HTTPS required; page shows no status or date
checked.evidence: Transformation table matches; no status label or date on the page.

checked.claim: did:webvh v1.0: did.jsonl at .well-known, media type text/jsonl, SCID SHA-256 multihash, eddsa-jcs-2022 proofs, parameter value did:webvh:1.0, parameters updateKeys, nextKeyHashes, portable, witness, deactivated
checked.evidence: All match in the first 100000 characters; no publication date shown. File's L10 lists 'newDomain' among portability items: not found as a parameter in the part read, and alsoKnownAs is a DID-document entry, not a parameter.
checked.correction: Describe alsoKnownAs as a DID-document entry and drop or verify 'newDomain'.

checked.claim: OpenID4VCI 1.0 Final 2025-09-16 (sections 4, 8; /.well-known/openid-credential-issuer; nonce, deferred, notification endpoints); OpenID4VP 1.0 Final 2025-07-09 (dcql_query, direct_post, direct_post.jwt, decentralized_identifier and x509_san_dns prefixes, DC API annex)
checked.evidence: VCI: Final, 16 Sep 2025, endpoints and section numbers as stated. VP (https://openid.net/specs/openid-4-verifiable-presentations-1_0.html): Final, 9 Jul 2025, Appendix A is the DC API annex.

checked.claim: draft-ietf-oauth-sd-jwt-vc-19 is an Internet-Draft, Waiting for AD Go-Ahead, not an RFC; media type application/dc+sd-jwt
checked.evidence: Revision 19, active I-D, IESG state Waiting for AD Go-Ahead, no RFC number; section 2.1 requires application/dc+sd-jwt.

checked.claim: SD-JWT is RFC 9901, Proposed Standard, November 2025
checked.evidence: Title 'Selective Disclosure for JSON Web Tokens' and Proposed Standard status confirmed; the publication month was not visible in the fetched part (only a 2025 copyright year), so 'November 2025' is not confirmed by this fetch.

checked.claim: Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 Art. 11 points (a)-(h), implementing act on digital credentials under Art. 73(3), delegated act on service providers; Art. 10(1)(a)-(e), 10(4)
checked.evidence: Consolidated text (pdftotext of the cellar PDF) shows Art. 11 first subparagraph (a)-(h) exactly as the file uses them: (g) authentication/reliability/integrity, (h) security, privacy, fraud; fourth subparagraph is an implementing act under Art. 73(3) ('may adopt'). Art. 10(1)(a)-(g) and 10(4) match. EUR-Lex /eng URL returned empty content to WebFetch.

checked.claim: Art. 12(1), 12(4)-(5)(c) identifier rules; Art. 13(2)(a), 13(5), Art. 15(1)-(2) registration identifier and customs check
checked.evidence: 12(5)(c) 'reliable, verifiable and unique globally'; 13(2)(a) authenticity verification criterion; 13(5) registration identifier plus implementing act; 15(1)-(2) customs checks match.

checked.claim: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1778 Art. 4 lets operators gain verified status with qualified signature/seal, eID high or (qualified) EAA, valid at most three years (Art. 4(4)); Art. 3(b),(d),(e)
checked.evidence: Number, title (registry implementation arrangements), date 16 July 2026, OJ 17.7.2026 confirmed. Means differ by operator type: eID 'high' is open only to sole traders established in the Union; legal persons use qualified seal or (qualified) EAA; non-EU persons have EAA variants. Art. 4(4) three-year cap confirmed.
checked.correction: Qualify the list per operator type: eID high applies only to sole traders established in the Union.

checked.claim: version.json pins UNTP 0.7.0, VCkit 1.2.1, storage 4.0.0, IDR 4.0.0; storage service has POST /public and /private, digestMultibase, decryptionKey for /private, AES-256-GCM, DELETE; playground verify route sets fetchRemoteContexts true and credentialStatus policy false; validityWindow module exists
checked.evidence: Read via gh api: version.json on branch next, storage README, playground api/verify/route.ts (lines 23-25) and lib/validityWindow.ts. The storage README says an API key is required for /public, /private and DELETE; the file omits this.

checked.claim: DIA subject has registeredId and schemeId; accessRole is matched against registrationScopeList in DIAs
checked.evidence: The 0.7.0 DIA schema has properties registeredId, idScheme (an object), registerType, registrar, registrationScope (array of URIs, not required); required: id, registeredName, registeredId, registeredDate, idScheme, registerType. schemeId and registrationScopeList do not exist in the schema. The DAC prose page does say registrationScopeList, so the spec itself is inconsistent. DIA requirement levels (DIA-01/02/05/06 MUST, DIA-03/08 SHOULD) are right.
checked.correction: Use idScheme and registrationScope as schema names; flag the prose-versus-schema mismatch (registrationScopeList in DAC page) as a finding.

checked.claim: Existing integrity.jws needs typ dpp+jws, x5c chain, ES256 P-256 key and only headers alg, kid, typ, x5c, so a vc+jwt cannot verify
checked.evidence: ALLOWED_ALGORITHMS = ES256 only; _SUPPORTED_HEADERS = alg,kid,typ,x5c; PASSPORT_TYP = dpp+jws in adapters/integrity.py; INTEGRITY.KEY.UNSUPPORTED raised when x5c missing (integrity.py:162); a cty header falls under the unsupported-header rule.

checked.claim: Existing checks identifier.consistency, identifier.resolve, data.context, data.jsonschema, access.restricted_fields, persistence.versions, manual.review exist; integrity.status_list and registry.official and persistence.scheduled are interface_only; api.contract supports GET only; evidence.status_list decodes a Bitstring Status List file
checked.evidence: Grep of src shows each id registered; adapters/api.py defaults method to get and returns unsupported for others; capabilities.py describes evidence.status_list as verifying an operator-supplied signed status list with the W3C encoding, integrity.status_list as interface-only.

Crossref/OpenAlex titles match exactly: Applied Sciences 2024-06-04; OreProof and interID preprints 2026; DAPPS 2025-07-21; SOSE 2024-07-15; Electronic Markets 2024-01-25; Construction Innovation 2025-12-09; BISE Oct 2021; RFC 9943 is a Crossref 'report' issued June 2026 (RFC stream/status not read, as the file says).

checked.claim: Survey on DIDs and VCs has year 2024
checked.evidence: Crossref gives vol. 27, issue 6, issued and print date 2025-12; no online date in the record. The file notes the mismatch but keeps 2024.
checked.correction: Set year 2025 (Crossref issued) and record 2024 only as search-tool year.

checked.claim: VCALM v1.0 draft (formerly VC API): POST /credentials/issue, POST /workflows and /exchanges, authorization classes public/permissioned/bound, long-lived static credentials such as HTTP Basic forbidden, production use discouraged
checked.evidence: All stated points present. 'Formerly VC API' is supported by the archived w3c-ccg/vc-api repo (description: Redirection to VCALM spec) and the w3c/vcalm README.

checked.claim: DI 1.0 and ECDSA 1.0 Recommendations 2025-05-15; ecdsa-sd-2023 base header d9 5d 00, derived d9 5d 01, u prefix; P-256 64 bytes, P-384 96 bytes; errors PROOF_VERIFICATION_ERROR, INVALID_DOMAIN_ERROR, INVALID_CHALLENGE_ERROR; undefined terms dropped in expansion must error
checked.evidence: Both pages: Recommendation 15 May 2025; byte headers and sizes as stated. Data Integrity section 4.7 lists five errors (also PROOF_GENERATION_ERROR, PROOF_TRANSFORMATION_ERROR); section 2.4.3 requires an error on data loss, SHOULD named DATA_LOSS_DETECTION_ERROR (https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-data-integrity/).

checked.claim: EBSI: 20 production nodes, 10 Member States in governance, EUPL, trusted issuers ecosystem 'coming soon', full service later in 2026
checked.evidence: Portal states all four facts.

checked.claim: tests-untp issue #1096: v0.8.0 schemas use a digit string for statusListIndex, any status purpose, several entries, size/message/reference fields; issue open, updated 2026-10-06
checked.evidence: Issue open, opened 2026-09-28, tracks spec commit 437c56c5; changes merged into unreleased v0.8.0 (MRs !870-!872). GitHub API lists the title 'Track the UNTP changes since v0.7.0 and the work each product needs'. Issue says released 0.7.0 schemas keep old rules.

checked.claim: Commission slides of 11 June 2026 place the credentials implementing act in Q2 2027 and the service-provider delegated act in Q1 2027
checked.evidence: Only secondary_only source in the file (a Turkish ministry copy of a slide deck); not re-fetched here. The legal text itself (Art. 11) says 'may adopt' with no deadline, which supports 'not adopted' but not the dates.

missed_items.topic: W3C Data Integrity data-loss error name
missed_items.fact: Section 2.4.3 requires an error when JSON-LD processing drops data and recommends the name DATA_LOSS_DETECTION_ERROR; it is absent from the section 4.7 error list. A JSON-LD expansion check should use this name.

The standard defines 400 for invalid request URI, 404 for unknown entity or missing requested link type, 300 for several equal matches, and forbids 200 for error conditions. A resolver test oracle can use these.
The authoritative tags are on the UN/CEFACT GitLab; the GitHub mirror uncefact/spec-untp stops at v0.6.1 (pushed 2025-11-14). Release candidates v0.7.0-rc7 and rc8 are dated one day after v0.7.0.
The 0.7.0 DPP schema types the index as integer but its own description text says a base-10 string, so even a schema-valid UNTP 0.7.0 credential can fail strict W3C verifiers.
Writes to /public, /private and DELETE need an API key; a loopback fixture for the storage service should model 401 without it.

The schema property is registrationScope (optional array of URIs) and the scheme is the idScheme object; the DAC prose uses registrationScopeList. A DIA check must follow the schema and tolerate or flag the prose name.

overall: The target file is largely reliable: versions, statuses, dates, licences, push dates, DOIs and EU article lettering all matched primary sources, and the engine mapping (integrity.jws limits, GET-only api.contract, interface_only capabilities) matches the code. Three real errors were found: the UNTP WIP JOSE-or-COSE rule is stated as MUST though the page marks it as a proposal, the DIA property names schemeId and registrationScopeList do not exist in the 0.7.0 schema (the spec prose and schema disagree), and the survey DOI year should be 2025. Smaller gaps: the eID-high option applies only to sole traders in Implementing Regulation 2026/1778 Art. 4, the SD-JWT RFC month and the Commission slide dates were not confirmed, and did:webvh 'newDomain' was not found. No rule 5 problems were found: protected standards are named only bibliographically.
